# dazo — fixed-price remote build studio

> dazo builds websites, mobile apps, chat bots and AI workflows, and fixes technical SEO and page speed, at a published fixed price with the delivery window agreed before the project starts. Everything is ordered by email: hkay7645@gmail.com

There is no order form, no checkout and no account on this site — that is deliberate. Every page ends at the same email address, written as plain text so it can be typed by hand. Payment is USDT on BEP-20 or ERC-20 only, never TRC-20.

## Services

- [Website development](https://fyosamu.github.io/web-development/): custom websites, e-commerce stores, corporate sites, SaaS dashboards and landing pages. Theme-based or fully bespoke, from $450, delivered in 3–7 days, source handed over.
- [Website to mobile app](https://fyosamu.github.io/website-to-app/): turn an existing website into an Android and iOS app with push notifications and offline loading, from $600, delivered in 4–8 days.
- [Telegram and chat bot development](https://fyosamu.github.io/telegram-bot-development/): Telegram, Discord and WhatsApp bots — moderation, payment gates, RSS auto-posting, mini-apps — from $350, delivered in 2–5 days.
- [AI workflow automation](https://fyosamu.github.io/ai-automation/): n8n / Make / Zapier pipelines, LLM agents and RAG over your own documents, CRM sync, internal tools, from $550, delivered in 3–7 days.
- [Technical SEO audit and fixes](https://fyosamu.github.io/technical-seo/): crawlability, indexing, schema markup, internal linking and content structure, with the fixes applied rather than just listed. From $300, scoped per site.
- [Speed optimisation](https://fyosamu.github.io/speed-optimization/): Core Web Vitals, image pipelines, critical CSS, caching, CDN and bundle trimming, with a Lighthouse run before and after. From $250, delivered in 1–3 days.
- [Website care plan](https://fyosamu.github.io/website-care-plan/): backups, updates, security hardening, uptime monitoring and human support. $90 per month, cancel whenever.

## Pricing and ordering

- [Pricing](https://fyosamu.github.io/pricing/): every price in one place — website $450, site to app $600, chat bots $350, AI automation $550, technical SEO $300, speed optimisation $250, care plan $90 per month. No discovery call is needed to see a number.
- [Home](https://fyosamu.github.io/): service overview, technical SEO and performance work, and the products available to buy right now.
- [Partner program](https://fyosamu.github.io/partners/): bring a project, keep 15% of the fee, paid in USDT within 24 hours of the payment clearing.

## Free tools

- [Website cost calculator](https://fyosamu.github.io/tools/website-cost-calculator/): pick a scope, get an instant fixed price in USD and USDT plus the typical market range for comparison. No email required.
- [Telegram bot cost calculator](https://fyosamu.github.io/tools/telegram-bot-cost-calculator/): choose features and message volume, get the build price and a realistic monthly hosting estimate.
